name: Eptalofosuchus
sum: Eptalofosuchus is a notosuchian known from a fragmentary mandible from the Campanian Uberaba Formation of Brazil.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: A fragmentary mandible from the Uberaba Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
